name: PreparedFrameStep

test_list.description: Default limits are finite and valid; zero, over-ceiling, and result-greater-than-record configurations fail.
Preparation rejects unsupported schema, step zero, and result counts beyond the configured bound.
Preparation rejects oversized model-visible tool content and escaped serialized records without emitting an oversized encoding.
The maximum serialized record size is inclusive at the exact encoded boundary and rejects a bound one byte smaller.
Across ordinary and JSON-escaped goal strings, preparation accepts precisely when the canonical encoded bytes fit the configured bound.
A prepared record exposes only safe metadata in Debug and persistence returns only after exact, hash-matched CAS readback.
Every raw tool receipt must exist, fit its read bound, and hash to its referenced CID before the transcript is stored.
A store that ignores the requested read bound cannot smuggle an oversized receipt through with a valid content hash.
The model-visible content CID must resolve to the exact bounded expected text and matching content hash.
A store returning a CID for other bytes or corrupt bytes on transcript readback cannot produce a successful persistence result.
The event is appended after transcript verification; CAS failure appends no event, while event failure leaves the already stored transcript as an orphan.
The prepared transcript survives bounded persistence and hash verification through the production CAS implementation.

inputs.name: record
inputs.description: Complete one-based frame step transcript and terminal outcome.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Validated record, tool result byte, and result count bounds.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Synchronous CAS backend; calls may block and must run off latency-sensitive executors.

output_description: A content identifier only after bounded encoding, referenced-content verification, CAS storage, and exact hash-checked readback.
